analysis:
The only change in SSDPrefixCache.swift is the evictOldestEntry refactor (patch @@ -1770,21 +1770,12 @@, base 1773-1787, head 1773-1778). The base loop over index.oldestEntries() behaved as follows: on retired.externalChange it returned 0; on the first victim with indexedBytesFreed > 0 it counted one eviction and returned those bytes; it skipped valid but undeletable victims. The head delegates this to SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.evictOldest(index:) with a closure that calls the unchanged retireIndexedEntries([url]). It then counts the eviction in the caller only when freed > 0.

Neither supplied unit shows the changed lines. Unit :5 is base lines 1838-2193 and unit :6 is head lines 1-656. The new helper's implementation is also not supplied. I therefore cannot verify that it preserves three base semantics: (1) an external change stops eviction (return 0), (2) it is bounded by the snapshot and moves past an undeletable victim to a newer one, and (3) only indexed bytes freed are reported. A divergence would affect the T-041(b) box-wide LRU disk budget and availability (over-eviction, or a stalled budget that refuses donations). It would not affect confidentiality, because file deletion still goes through retireIndexedEntries, performIndexedRemoval/ownsEvictionRoot and the hasSafeRoot guard at head 1772.

The unchanged surrounding code supports this. In the base text, the TTL sweep (1850-1857), startup scan symlink/safe-URL fail-closed checks (1865-1966), settleDurableDonation decrypt-verify (2052-2134) and removal locking (2013-2026) are untouched. In the head text, the HMAC names, staging and ticket pins, and close/release paths (430-462, 595-652) are untouched.

No T-041 at-rest regression was identified. Integration should inspect SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.evictOldest, which is likely in another file of this PR, for the semantics listed above.
